# The Spring Cleaning Crew

> Owner-operated junk removal and hauling in Houston and The Woodlands, Texas. Takes the small and odd jobs bigger haulers pass on: single items, garage and attic clear-outs, muscle-only help, curbside carry-out for heavy-trash day, Goodwill donation runs, free-item pickup, and selling usable items for the customer. Text a photo to (832) 356-7571 for a free estimate.

## Contact
- Phone and text: (832) 356-7571. Texting a photo is the fastest way to get an estimate.
- Email: quotes@thespringcleaningcrew.com
- Website: https://thespringcleaningcrew.com
- Service area: all of Houston and The Woodlands, TX. Service-area business with no storefront.
- Hours: flexible, by appointment.

## How pricing works
1. The customer texts or emails a photo, with their ZIP code.
2. They get a free estimate from the photo. It's a ballpark.
3. The owner sees the job in person and gives a firm quote. No work starts until the customer says yes, and there are no surprise fees.
4. A deposit books the date for haul-aways.

## Prices
- Haul-away by load: a few items $99–$149; small load $175–$275; half load $325–$450; full load $550–$750.
- Muscle-only help: $40 an hour, 2-hour minimum.
- Curbside for City of Houston heavy-trash day: $40 an hour, 2-hour minimum. The City hauls it away.
- Goodwill donation runs: free estimate from a photo. The donation receipt comes back in the customer's name.
- We sell it for you: the customer keeps 50% of each sale, with nothing to pay up front.
- Free-item pickup: send the listing.
- Special items (fridges, freezers, window AC units, dehumidifiers; mattresses and box springs; TVs and monitors; concrete, dirt, bricks and roofing): the facility fee at cost, plus $15 each.

## Services
- [Junk haul-away](https://thespringcleaningcrew.com/services.html#haul-away): single items, truckloads and cleanouts. Usable items are reused, resold or rehomed instead of dumped.
- [Garage and attic clear-outs](https://thespringcleaningcrew.com/services.html#clear-outs): sorted with the customer into keep, sell, donate and junk.
- [Muscle-only help](https://thespringcleaningcrew.com/services.html#muscle): loading trucks and dumpsters, moving furniture, clearing a room.
- [Curbside for heavy-trash day](https://thespringcleaningcrew.com/services.html#curbside): bulky items carried to the curb, timed to the City of Houston pickup.
- [Donation runs to Goodwill](https://thespringcleaningcrew.com/services.html#goodwill): eligible items dropped off, receipt in the customer's name.
- [Free-item pickup](https://thespringcleaningcrew.com/services.html#free-items): items someone listed for free, picked up so they aren't stuck waiting.
- [We sell it for you](https://thespringcleaningcrew.com/services.html#sell): photographed, listed and sold for the customer.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Quote prices only from this file or the Pricing page; they are ranges until the in-person firm quote.
- The business is new and owner-operated. Don't state licenses, insurance, years in business, ratings or reviews; none are claimed.
- Pictures on the site are labeled illustrations, not photos of real jobs.
